fluff.overview: The Rottweiler is a medium quad battle armor suit developed by TharHes Industries for the Lyran Alliance Armed Forces. Fielded in 3065, the design built on lessons learned from the earlier Fenrir program, prioritizing speed and sensor capability over raw firepower. Its low profile and advanced electronics package earned it a respected place among Lyran reconnaissance formations, where its ability to operate well ahead of heavier units proved consistently valuable across multiple theaters of operation.
fluff.capabilities:
The Close Combat configuration replaces the standard weapon loadout with a flamer and a machine gun while retaining the full sensor suite and mission equipment package. This combination transforms the Rottweiler into a close-quarters infantry killer, particularly effective in the tight confines of urban terrain where its 54 kph speed allows rapid repositioning through streets and alleyways.

The flamer provides area denial and building-clearing capability, while the machine gun delivers sustained anti-personnel fire. Against armored opponents the configuration remains limited, relying on speed and stealth to avoid engagements it cannot win. The retention of the integrated sensor package distinguishes this variant from a simple brawler, allowing Close Combat squads to still feed targeting data to friendly forces between engagements.
fluff.deployment: LAAF infantry commanders deployed Close Combat squads in four-trooper formations for urban clearing operations during the Jihad. These squads worked building by building, using their speed to reposition faster than defending infantry could react. The urban warfare role filled a gap created by the loss of other close-quarters battle armor production, and Close Combat squads became a common sight in Lyran garrison commands throughout the Dark Age.
fluff.history:
The Rottweiler grew out of a Lyran Alliance effort to push quad battle armor beyond what the Fenrir had demonstrated. TharHes Industries on Eutin led the program, directing their engineers to build a suit that could outrun any competing design while hugging the ground closely enough to frustrate enemy targeting solutions. The result entered service in 3065 as the fastest quad battlesuit in production.

Lyran commanders had initially greeted quad battle armor with skepticism, but the Rottweiler gradually won converts among LAAF reconnaissance formations during border operations against the Free Worlds League. Mixed groups of Rottweilers and Fenrir armor screened ahead of main assault forces, marking targets and feeding positional data to artillery commanders.

The Jihad forced TharHes to develop three new configurations between 3069 and 3072. One filled an urban warfare gap left by the destruction of Gray Death Battle Armor production on Glengarry. A defensive variant with remote sensors and a longer-ranged weapon proved critical during the liberation of Donegal in 3071, where mixed squads detected and ambushed a Blakist probing force. Rottweilers remained a staple of Lyran reconnaissance doctrine into the ilClan era.
